subject: Environmental Studies
stem: The energy possessed by a moving object due to its motion — greater when the object moves faster or has more mass — is called:
explanation: Kinetic energy is the energy of motion (depending on mass and speed), while potential energy is stored energy due to position or configuration — as when a ball falls, its potential energy converts to kinetic energy.

section: Science (Paper-2) · Ch — Force, Motion & Energy — Deep 2
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: Energy can neither be created nor destroyed, only converted from one form to another — for example, chemical energy in fuel converting to heat and mechanical energy in a car engine. This fundamental principle is called the:
explanation: The law of conservation of energy states that the total energy in an isolated system remains constant — energy only transforms between forms (kinetic, potential, chemical, thermal, etc.), never being created or destroyed.
